express_project.subtitle: Create a job completion report in seconds

tutorials.title: Tutorials
tutorials.intro: Step-by-step guides right inside the app. You perform the real actions: the data is actually created.
tutorials.none: No tutorial available with your permissions.
tutorials.fill_required: Fill in the required fields (*) to continue.
tutorials.action_hint: Tap the highlighted element to continue.
tutorials.target_missing: This step could not be displayed. The tutorial was stopped.

create_client.title: Create a client
create_client.desc: Add your first client in 1 minute
create_client.new_body: Start by tapping this button to add a client.
create_client.name_body: Enter the client's first and last name.
create_client.email_body: The email is used to send documents and signature links.
create_client.phone_body: The number is optional. It is formatted automatically when you leave the field.
create_client.address_body: Type the address: suggestions appear, pick the right one.
create_client.notes_body: You can add a useful detail (access, dog, gate code…). This field is optional: go to the next step if you don't need it.
create_client.submit_body: Tap here to create the client.
create_client.done_body: The client is saved. You can now add a project for them.

create_project.title: Create a project
create_project.desc: Plan a new project for a client
create_project.new_body: Tap this button to create a project.
create_project.title_body: The reference is required: enter the one you want to identify the project. Also give it a clear title, for example “Terrace and planting”.
create_project.title_body_autoref: The reference is required, but it is numbered automatically: you have nothing to enter (you can change it if needed). Just give the project a clear title, for example “Terrace and planting”.
create_project.client_body: Search for the client by name and pick them from the list. No client yet? Quit this guide and run "Create a client" first.
create_project.address_body: This is where the work takes place. If it is the same as the client's billing address, turn on the switch.
create_project.planning_body: You can enter the planned start and end dates and the quote amount. These fields are optional.
create_project.submit_body: Tap here to create the project.
create_project.done_body: The project is created as a draft. Then assign at least one employee to schedule it.

express_project.title: Quick job
express_project.desc: Create client, project and report in one step
express_project.new_body: For an on-site job, tap the lightning bolt: a client, a project and a report are created in one go.
express_project.client_body: Enter the client's first name, last name and email. These are the only required fields.
express_project.project_body: Title, address and description are optional: you can complete them later.
express_project.submit_body: Tap here to create the job.
express_project.done_body: You are on the report. Add the services performed, then send the signature link to the client.

create_role.title: Create a role
create_role.desc: Define what each team member can do
create_role.tab_body: Roles are managed in the "Roles" tab. Tap it to display it.
create_role.new_body: Tap this button to create a role.
create_role.name_body: Give it a meaningful name, for example "Team leader" or "Worker".
create_role.permissions_body: Tick what the role can do in each module: view, create, edit, delete. The ✓ on the right ticks the whole row.
create_role.submit_body: Tap here to create the role.
create_role.done_body: You can now assign it to a member: expand their card in the "Members" tab and pick the role.

send_signature.title: Send a signature link
send_signature.desc: Have the client sign on site or remotely
send_signature.choose_body: When a project is finished, the client must sign. You have two options.
send_signature.onsite_body: You hand your phone to the client, who signs in front of you. Handy at the end of the job.
send_signature.remote_body: The client receives a link by email and signs whenever they want, from their phone or computer.
send_signature.done_body: Nothing was sent during this guide. Pick the right option when the client is ready to sign.
send_signature.none_1_title: No project to sign right now
send_signature.none_1_body: No project is awaiting signature. Here is the screen you will see on a project at this stage:
send_signature.none_2_title: Two ways to get a signature
send_signature.none_2_body: "Sign now": the client signs on your phone, in front of you. "Send signature link": the client receives an email and signs whenever they want.
send_signature.none_3_body: A project becomes awaiting signature when the site manager closes it (before/after photos and comment filled in). Run this tutorial again then: it will guide you more precisely, right on your project.

sign_page.title: How to sign
sign_page.desc: The steps to approve the work
sign_page.report_body: Browse the photos and the work performed before making up your mind.
sign_page.report_body_onsite: Browse the photos and the work performed with the company's representative before making up your mind.
sign_page.accepted_body: Everything is as planned: choose “Works accepted”. You will then only need to sign.
sign_page.reserves_body: The work is fine but some defects remain: choose “Accepted with snagging list” and describe them. The company will come back to fix them, then you will confirm the reservations are cleared with a second signature.
sign_page.refused_body: You do not agree with the work: choose “Works refused” and explain why. No signature is requested; the company is informed and will contact you.
sign_page.identity_body: To accept (with or without reservations): check your name and enter the place of signature.
sign_page.signature_body: Draw your signature with your finger, or with the mouse on a computer. “Clear and start over” lets you redo it.
sign_page.signature_body_onsite: Draw your signature with your finger in the box. “Clear and start over” lets you redo it.
sign_page.submit_body: When everything is filled in, tap this button. The signed report will be sent to you by email. Nothing is signed during this guide.

create_service.title: Create a service
create_service.desc: Add a service to your library
create_service.new_body: Tap this button to add a service to the library.
create_service.title_body: Give it a clear name, for example “Lawn mowing” or “Hedge trimming”.
create_service.unit_body: Add the unit if it matters: m², hour, flat rate… You can leave this field empty.
create_service.description_body: Add extra information about the service if needed.
create_service.submit_body: Tap here to add the service.
create_service.done_body: It is now in the library: you can pick it in the job reports.

create_member.title: Create a team member
create_member.tab_body: To add a member, first open the “Members” tab: tap it.
create_member.new_body: Tap this button to add a member to the team.
create_member.name_body: Enter the member's first and last name.
create_member.identifier_body: This is what the member will type to log in. It must be unique.
create_member.email_body: You can add it to be able to contact them. This field is optional.
create_member.password_body: Choose a password of at least 8 characters and give it to the member.
create_member.role_body: The role defines what the member can do in the app. You can create roles in the “Roles” tab.
create_member.submit_body: Tap here to create the account.
create_member.done_body: They can now log in. You can assign them to a project from the project page.

install_app.title: Install the app on your home screen
install_app.desc: Open it like a real app
install_app.open_body: Tap this button: the app will then open full screen, like a real app.
install_app.modal_body: The instructions adapt to your phone. On iPhone, installation is done from Safari.
install_app.done_body: Once installed, open Drakko from its icon on your home screen.

run_project.title: Prepare and close a project
run_project.desc: From scheduling to closing, step by step
run_project.stepper_body: A project moves forward stage by stage: draft, scheduled, in progress, awaiting signature, then completed. The current stage is highlighted. This guided tour changes nothing.
run_project.action_body: This button moves to the next stage: “Schedule”, then “Start project”, then “Close project”.
run_project.team_body: Assign here the members working on the project, preferably before scheduling it.
run_project.photos_body: Before closing, remember the before and after photos. Tap “Manage” to open the photos page.
run_project.before_body: Take photos of the site before the work starts.
run_project.after_body: Then photos of the result once the work is done.
run_project.back_body: Tap the arrow to go back to the project page.
run_project.report_body: The end-of-project comment is written in the report (“Edit” button): the client will see it before signing. The “Fill in the report” guide covers this step.
run_project.none_1_body: No project is in draft, scheduled or in progress. Here are the stages of a project:
run_project.none_2_body: “Schedule”, “Start project”, add the before/after photos and the comment, then “Close project”: the project then moves to awaiting signature.
run_project.none_3_body: Create a project (“Create a project” guide), then run this guide again: it will guide you directly on your project.

fill_report.title: Fill in the job report
fill_report.lines_body: List here what was done. The services appear in the report the client signs. This guided tour changes nothing.
fill_report.service_body: Pick a service from your library, or “Free entry” to write your own.
fill_report.complement_body: Add details if needed: quantity, area treated, description of the work…
fill_report.validate_body: “Add” adds the service to the report. During this guide these buttons are locked: nothing is saved.
fill_report.comment_body: Summarize the project: work done, remarks, points of attention. The client will see it before signing.
fill_report.save_body: “Save” keeps the comment. Remember it when you are done: this guide saves nothing.
fill_report.none_1_body: No project is in draft, scheduled or in progress. Here is the report page:
fill_report.none_2_body: Create a project (or a quick job), then run this guide again: it will guide you directly on its report.
